facts.fact: Simone 以"your girl"自称播出一则重要通告。
facts.anchor: This is your girl, Simone, with an important announcement.

facts.fact: 度假村气象预测系统探测到可能有雷暴正在逼近本区域。
facts.anchor: Our weather prediction system has picked up a possible thunderstorm closing in on the region.

facts.fact: 度假村正在密切监测，如遇恶劣天气所有户外区域将临时关闭。
